title.en: Shifts in aggregate demand and equilibrium

heading.kn: ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಚಲನೆಯೇ ಅಥವಾ ರೇಖೆಯ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರವೇ?

hook.en: When your family’s income rises, you spend more: that is a move along the same consumption line. But if a new metro project starts in Bengaluru, firms invest more at every income level. Then the whole AD line moves. What does each change do to equilibrium income?
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಆದಾಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿದಾಗ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಖರ್ಚು ಮಾಡುತ್ತೀರಿ: ಅದು ಅದೇ ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಚಲನೆ. ಆದರೆ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಮೆಟ್ರೋ ಯೋಜನೆ ಆರಂಭವಾದರೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಆದಾಯ ಮಟ್ಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ; ಇಡೀ AD ರೇಖೆ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಮತೋಲನ ಆದಾಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ಇವುಗಳ ಪರಿಣಾಮವೇನು?

objectives.en: Distinguish movement along AD from a shift of AD
Show the effect of a change in autonomous spending
Show the effect of a change in MPC

title.en: Movement along versus shift of the AD curve

body.en: The AD line is $AD = \bar{A} + cY$, where $\bar{A} = \bar{C} + \bar{I}$ is autonomous expenditure. A change in income Y moves us along the same line (induced change). A change in an autonomous component, $\bar{C}$ or $\bar{I}$, shifts the whole line up or down parallel to itself. A change in the MPC changes the slope: the line swings around its intercept.

points.en: Change in Y: movement along AD
Change in C̄ or Ī: parallel shift of AD
Change in MPC: change in slope of AD

narration.en: The AD line is AD = \bar{A} + cY, where \bar{A} = \bar{C} + \bar{I} is autonomous expenditure. A change in income Y moves us along the same line (induced change). A change in an autonomous component, \bar{C} or \bar{I}, shifts the whole line up or down parallel to itself. A change in the MPC changes the slope: the line swings around its intercept.
narration.kn: AD = Ā + cY, ಇಲ್ಲಿ Ā = C̄ + Ī ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತ ವೆಚ್ಚ. ಆದಾಯ ಬದಲಾದರೆ ಅದೇ ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಚಲನೆ. ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತ ಘಟಕ ಬದಲಾದರೆ ಇಡೀ ರೇಖೆ ಸಮಾಂತರವಾಗಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಅಥವಾ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರ. MPC ಬದಲಾದರೆ ರೇಖೆಯ ಇಳಿಜಾರು ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: A rise in autonomous investment

narration.en: A parallel upward shift of AD raises equilibrium income by more than the shift.

say.en: Start with AD one: autonomous spending 100, MPC 0.8. Equilibrium is at 500.
Investment rises by 40. The new line AD two is parallel and 40 higher.
The new equilibrium is at 700. Income rose by 200, five times the rise in investment.
If instead the MPC changes, the line swings around the same intercept and becomes steeper or flatter.

caption.en: AD1 = C̄ + Ī + cY (yellow), AD2 after a change ΔĪ (green), and the 45° line (white).

narration.en: Change investment by ΔĪ and watch AD shift parallel. Compare the rise in income with the rise in investment.

tryThis.en: With MPC 0.8, raise investment by 40. Is ΔY = 200?
Make ΔĪ negative. What happens to income?
Keep ΔĪ = 40 and raise the MPC. Why does ΔY grow?

problem.en: In an economy C̄ = 40, Ī = 60 and MPC = 0.8 (₹ crore). (a) Find equilibrium income. (b) Investment rises to 100; find the new equilibrium income. (c) Instead, with Ī = 60, the MPC rises to 0.9; find equilibrium income.

steps.en: A parallel shift and a steeper AD line both raise income; a higher MPC raises it a lot.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. In an economy C̄ = 40, Ī = 60 and MPC = 0.8 (₹ crore). (a) Find equilibrium income. (b) Investment rises to 100; find the new equilibrium income. (c) Instead, with Ī = 60, the MPC rises to 0.9; find equilibrium income.
Team quiz. Each team discusses and gives one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the PUC board, CBSE and CUET pattern.

points.en: A change in income causes a movement along the AD line.
points.kn: ಆದಾಯ ಬದಲಾದರೆ AD ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಚಲನೆ.

points.en: A change in C̄ or Ī shifts the AD line parallel to itself.
points.kn: C̄ ಅಥವಾ Ī ಬದಲಾದರೆ AD ರೇಖೆ ಸಮಾಂತರವಾಗಿ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರ.

points.en: A change in MPC changes the slope of the AD line.
points.kn: MPC ಬದಲಾದರೆ AD ರೇಖೆಯ ಇಳಿಜಾರು ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Equilibrium income changes by more than the change in autonomous spending.
points.kn: ಸಮತೋಲನ ಆದಾಯ ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

homework.en: Draw AD1 and AD2 for a fall in autonomous consumption and mark both equilibria.

narration.en: Recap. A change in income causes a movement along the AD line. A change in C̄ or Ī shifts the AD line parallel to itself. A change in MPC changes the slope of the AD line. Equilibrium income changes by more than the change in autonomous spending.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆದಾಯ ಬದಲಾದರೆ AD ರೇಖೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಚಲನೆ. C̄ ಅಥವಾ Ī ಬದಲಾದರೆ AD ರೇಖೆ ಸಮಾಂತರವಾಗಿ ಸ್ಥಳಾಂತರ. MPC ಬದಲಾದರೆ AD ರೇಖೆಯ ಇಳಿಜಾರು ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಮತೋಲನ ಆದಾಯ ಸ್ವಾಯತ್ತ ವೆಚ್ಚದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
